name: 欧德
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:2302
who: Ode, a human man who was the first king of the Sun Crown and has kept the fire at the east gate of the golden-kite city for thousands of years; a legend who has looked sixty-five ever since, about 168 cm, spare and bent in the back but with the neck held straight, a man who has never held a blade. Thick untidy white hair that looks dusted with ash, deep-set eyes the dark red of banked coals that look at people without ever dropping away. Weathered, creased hands blackened at the fingertips. He crouches by a fire adding sticks and looks up at whoever comes. Short in speech, patient, unimpressed by titles: he answers to 'old fire-keeper' and not to 'king'.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old man's lean face of about sixty-five, NOT young: deep-set, calm, slightly down-slanted eyes of dark coal red, white untidy brows; deep lines at the eyes and either side of the mouth; a straight nose; a thin, closed, patient mouth. Pale skin with soft ash-grey shading, skin shadows a soft cool grey.
build: 168 cm, spare and wiry, the back bent but the neck straight, thin strong forearms.
palette: ash grey and white, ember red, old patched leather brown, a little soot black
casual: His everyday dress at the east gate: the old patched hide cloak, burnt through in many places and mended with scraps of leather in a different shade each year, fastened at the throat with a bone pin, over a plain undyed wool tunic to the knees and old wool trousers wrapped at the shin, worn hide boots. A small leather pouch of tinder at his belt. He crouches a little with one hand open toward a fire outside the frame, looking up with a steady, patient gaze.
private: Sitting by the fire at night: the patched cloak off and folded under him, a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, old trousers and soft hide shoes. He holds a pair of iron fire-tongs and is turning a log, a quiet, absorbed look.
battle_pose: 3) the fire-keeper's stance for the road south, since he has never fought and carries no weapon: the patched cloak pulled tight, the hood back, both hands cupped in front of his chest holding a small living fire that lights his face from below, the feet planted, the neck straight, the head up, a calm, unbowed look.
battle: Carrying the fire south: the patched hide cloak belted tight with a leather cord, the tinder pouch at his hip, hide boots wrapped with thongs for the long road. He never fights and holds no weapon; in both hands he carries a cupped handful of living fire. A calm, unbowed look.
formal: The same patched hide cloak, brushed clean of ash and pinned at the throat, over a clean undyed wool tunic. He will not change it even for a crown, and stands very upright beside the east gate fire with the hands folded in front, a quiet, steady look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the white-haired old man looking straight at the viewer with calm coal-red eyes, the head held high. Warm firelight from below on one side lighting the creases of his face, cold blue dusk on the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and a curl of smoke. He wears the patched hide cloak with the bone pin.

name: 席恩
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:2319
who: Xien, called the Wakeful, the leader of the Nine Spears hunting band, a human who has had the face of a seventeen-year-old for over nine thousand years: about 172 cm, slender and light on his feet, wholly covered by his clothes. Long snow-white hair tied back at the nape with a leather cord, lake-grey-blue eyes that look steady and older than his face, a vertical scar standing upright between the brows where an ice spear once pressed, and a small teardrop mole under the right eye. A silver staff in his hand, its head notched on one side and its shaft carved all over with the rules of the Nine Spears. A light, steady, quiet air that gives nothing away. The silver staff is a plain walking staff and NOT a bladed weapon: its head is a smooth rounded silver knob about the size of a fist with one small square notch cut into one side of it, no blade of any kind, no hook, no points; the shaft below the knob is carved all round with small lines of script.
palette: snow white and frost grey-blue, deep slate grey, tarnished silver, a little birch-bark brown
casual: His hunting dress on the southern wall: the dark-grey Nine Spears hunting jacket buttoned to the throat with long fitted sleeves, a deep slate-grey wool cloak over it, grey trousers tucked into tall hide boots wrapped with thongs, leather gloves. In his right hand the silver staff carved with the Nine Spears' rules, its notched head up. A white ash-wood spear with a frost-white tip rides on his back. A calm, level look.
private: Resting by the fire behind the wall: a long-sleeved, high-collared undyed wool tunic in pale grey with a thick knitted scarf, plain trousers and soft hide boots, the white hair loose over one shoulder. He holds a small birch-bark pouch of written songs on his knee. A quiet, steady look.
battle: Keeping the night watch: the dark-grey hunting jacket and slate cloak, leather bracers over the sleeves, tall boots. He holds the white ash-wood ice spear in both hands, its tip sparkling with frost that never melts, aimed forward and slightly up; the silver staff is left planted in the ground behind him. A wide-awake, unflinching look, the eyes open, the mouth closed.
formal: At the muster of the southern wall: the Nine Spears hunting jacket brushed clean, grey-blue with a ring of nine small stitched marks on the left sleeve, bound cuffs, a slate-grey half-cloak pinned with a plain silver clasp, grey trousers bound at the shin, tall hide boots, the white hair freshly tied back. He stands very upright, both hands on the silver staff in front of him, frost glittering along its length, a serious, calm look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the eyes wide open and looking straight at the viewer, serious and older than the face, the mouth closed, the upright scar between the brows clear. Cold blue night light from one side and the warm glow of a campfire from the other. Foreground blur: drifting frost-white sparks and the tip of the frost spear. He wears the dark-grey hunting jacket and slate cloak.

name: 博尔·焦砧
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:2401
who: Bor of the Charred Anvil, a dwarf of the molten-iron forge-folk, the Cliff branch, who became a legend at a hundred and ninety and has looked the same ever since, a grown dwarf of middle years: about 138 cm, very short and extremely broad, forearms thicker than another man's calves. A brown-red beard, singed and regrown several times, plaited into two strands whose ends are each threaded through a small bronze nail. Small stone-blue eyes that study stone more carefully than people. Both forearms are covered in tiny white burn dots from forge sparks. A short, patient, gruff air of a nail-driver who listens to cliffs.
build: 138 cm, very short and extremely broad: a barrel chest, shoulders as wide as a door, thick arms and a low, steady stance.
palette: soot brown and bronze, stone blue, singed red-brown, dull iron grey
casual: His nail-driver's work clothes: a thick sleeveless leather jerkin over a heavy brown wool shirt with the sleeves rolled and bound tight at the forearms to show the white burn dots, wide leather belt, thick trousers and iron-toed boots. A leather pouch on his back holds a bundle of long bronze cliff nails taller than he is; the Charred Anvil family hammer hangs at his belt. He stands braced and still with one ear tilted as if listening to stone.
private: Off work in the stone halls: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed to the elbows, a worn leather apron, short trousers and soft felt shoes. He rests one big hand flat on a stone wall and tilts his head, listening. A relaxed, gruff look.
battle: Driving nails into a cliff face: a heavy leather and plate jerkin with iron shoulder guards over the wool shirt, forearm guards, a coil of rope belted at the waist. In his right hand he raises the heavy family hammer overhead, in his left he holds one long bronze nail set against the rock; the nail bundle stays on his back. Planted wide, a hard, focused look.
formal: At the muster of the southern wall: a clean leather and wool vest over a pale shirt with sleeves rolled to the white burn dots, a Charred Anvil crest stitched in orange on a leather shoulder cape, a broad belt with a plain bronze buckle, the braided beard freshly combed, the two bronze nails at its ends polished and faintly red as if just from the forge. He stands very upright with the hands folded in front, the hammer left unhooked, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the small stone-blue eyes narrowed in concentration, looking at the viewer with a gruff, steady look. Warm orange forge light from one side and cold blue stone light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and a long bronze nail held up in a big scorched fist. He wears the sleeveless leather jerkin, the beard plaits with their bronze nails in clear focus.

name: 菲恩瑞丝
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:2456
who: Fenruis of the Watchers' clan, an elf archer of the southern wall, five hundred years old and looking in her twenties: about 172 cm, tall, slim and long-limbed, straight in the shoulders and back. Long honey-gold hair in one braid coiled at the back of her head, long pointed ears. Both eyes were once green and are now clouded with a white film as if seen through mist: she can see light and shadow but not faces. The first two fingers of her drawing hand are thick-jointed from the bowstring. A pale-green mist-blind gaze that always seems turned a little to one side, listening. A calm, level, listening air. Her blindness must show: both eyes are covered by a milky, semi-opaque white film that greys out the pale green and nearly hides the pupils, like eyes seen through frost, the same in every panel, and the gaze never focuses on the viewer.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young elf woman's calm, narrow face of about twenty-five: long gently up-slanted eyes whose irises are pale green veiled by a milky white film, the gaze unfocused and slightly to one side; straight pale-gold brows; a straight nose; a closed, level mouth. Pale clean skin with very little shading.
build: 172 cm, slim and long-limbed: straight, strong shoulders and back, a B-cup, a narrow waist and lightly rounded hips.
palette: honey gold and watcher grey-green, white fir wood, a faded mist white
casual: Her Watchers' clan dress: a fresh grey-green hooded cloak, new this spring and not yet sun-faded, over a close-fitting grey-green tunic to mid-thigh with fitted sleeves and a bound waist, fitted trousers and soft tall boots, leather bracers on both forearms. Her long white-fir bow rides unstrung across her back, the wood polished smooth by years of use. She stands with her head tilted a little, listening.
private: Resting in a wall-top watch room: a long-sleeved, high-collared soft grey linen dress to the shins, a thick wool shawl, soft indoor boots, the braid let down over one shoulder. She runs her fingertips along the grain of a bow that rests on her knees. A quiet, listening look.
battle: Shooting by ear on the wall: the grey-green tunic with a quilted leather chest guard, leather bracers, the hood thrown back, the braid pinned up. She holds the white-fir long bow fully drawn, the arrow pointing out at the unseen enemy, the head turned slightly to the sound, the milky eyes open; nothing is slung on her back. A still, unflinching look.
formal: At the muster of the southern wall: a clean long grey-green Watchers' cloak with a silver leaf clasp over a pale grey tunic-dress, the braid freshly coiled. She holds the unstrung bow upright at her side, standing very straight, a grave, listening look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned a little, the milky green eyes looking just past the viewer as if toward a sound, the mouth closed. Pale grey mist light from one side with a faint cold-white rim light. Foreground blur: a drifting fall of fog and the tip of a white arrow. She wears the grey-green hooded cloak. The milky white film over both pale-green eyes is clearly visible, the pupils barely showing, the unfocused gaze turned a little to one side.

name: 露卡
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:2511
who: Luka of the Bell-tail folk, a fox-eared beastkin woman who leads cart trains and looks thirty, the age she became a legend: about 158 cm, small, sturdy and long-legged, running as if pressed close to the ground. Very short cropped white-gold hair, a pair of upright furred ears of the same pale gold, and a full tail with a small brass bell tied at its tip that jingles whenever she runs. The veins on her neck and the backs of her hands show darker and deeper than elsewhere, the mark of a body that has burned blood. A big coil of rope hung with small brass bells at arm's length across her shoulder. A brisk, fearless, stubborn air.
build: 158 cm, small, sturdy and long-legged: strong shoulders and back, a B-cup, a trim waist and firm, muscular hips.
palette: white gold, grey leather and rope brown, brass, dusty red thread
casual: Her Bell-tail cart-leader gear: a short grey leather jerkin with fitted sleeves over a plain wool shirt, a belt ringed with rope loops, fitted trousers and soft boots; across her body a big coil of rope strung with small brass bells at arm's length, worn from the left shoulder to the right hip. The brass bell at the tail tip. She stands with her weight on the balls of her feet, a quick, confident grin.
private: Off the road in a wagon camp: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt with the cuffs rolled once, plain trousers, bare feet in soft slippers, the rope coil set on the ground beside her. She sits with her tail curled round her feet, listening to the bell, a relaxed, sleepy smile.
battle: Pulling the line at a collapsing city wall: the grey leather jerkin buckled tight with a leather chest guard, leather bracers and gloves, the cuffs bound. She holds a loop of the belled rope taut between both fists, pulling hard with the feet braced and the weight back; the bells ring along the line. A fierce, determined look.
formal: At the muster of the southern wall: the Bell-tail cart-leader's grey leather jerkin brushed clean over a plain shirt, sleeves bound at the cuffs, a dusty red sash, a short grey cape with a ring of small brass bells sewn along its edge, the rope coil neatly wound on her shoulder, the tail bell polished and softly ringing. She stands very straight, a proud, calm look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, upright furred ears and bright eyes looking straight at the viewer with a bold, cheerful grin. Warm low sun from one side, cool dust haze on the other. Foreground blur: drifting dust, a brass bell on a rope swinging near the lens. She wears the grey leather jerkin.

name: 瓦尔克斯
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:2566
who: Valkes, a half-orc legend of the southern wall who guards the city gates, looking forty: about 218 cm, so tall he lowers his head to pass any doorway, shoulders as wide as half a gate, heavy-boned and thick-armed. Grey-green skin; the left tusk is snapped off at half its length (it is on the viewer's right when they face us). Short dark hair, small dark eyes that crinkle when he grins. Across his back, from shoulder blades to waist, runs a door-wide old scar, hidden under his clothes. A broken iron door bar longer than a man, used as staff and hammer, rests in his hand. His laugh can be heard down the whole street. A big, warm, steady air. Two tusks rise from his lower jaw and show whenever the mouth opens: the right tusk (on the viewer's left when he faces us) is whole, long and pointed; the left tusk (on the viewer's right) is a short stub snapped off at half its length with a flat broken end. Draw both tusks exactly this way in every panel. Tusk check, repeated: the two lower tusks must look clearly different at a glance. The right tusk (on the viewer's left when he faces us) is long and comes to a point. The left tusk (on the viewer's right) is a broken stump only about HALF that length, ending in a flat, squared-off broken edge and never in a point; this difference is obvious in every panel, in the portrait and in every expression that shows the teeth.
palette: grey-green skin, rust-iron and dull steel, worn leather brown, faded red cloth
casual: His gate-keeper's dress: a thick sleeveless leather jerkin over a coarse brown wool shirt with the sleeves bound at the forearm, a wide belt, heavy trousers and iron-shod boots, bare forearms scarred. In his right hand he leans on a broken iron door bar longer than a man, its snapped end resting on the ground. A wide, warm grin that shows the broken tusk.
private: Off duty in the gate-house: a big loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up, plain wide trousers and soft shoes. He sits on a bench with a child's wooden cart on his knee, turning one wheel with a huge finger. A warm, relaxed grin.
battle: Holding a gate against a wall of enemies: the leather jerkin reinforced with iron plates on the shoulders and forearms, a heavy belt, iron-shod boots. He holds the broken iron door bar across his body in both hands like a bar across a gate, planted wide with the knees bent, taking the weight. A fierce, steady look.
formal: At the muster of the southern wall: a clean sleeveless leather gate-keeper's jerkin with iron studs over a dark brown wool shirt, a gate-key sigil sewn in white on the chest, a broad belt with a plain iron buckle, iron-shod boots polished, scarred forearms bare, the broken door bar held upright at his side with a faint rune glowing along the break. He stands very straight, ducking slightly under the lintel of the frame, a proud, quiet grin.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the small dark eyes crinkled in a big laugh that shows the broken left tusk, a hand resting on the door bar. Warm low sun from one side, cool dust haze on the other. Foreground blur: drifting dust and the rusty iron bar. He wears the sleeveless leather jerkin over the brown shirt. The laugh shows both lower tusks: the whole long right tusk on the viewer's left and the short snapped-off left tusk on the viewer's right. The broken left tusk (on the viewer's right) is plainly a short flat-ended stump, half the length of the pointed right tusk.

name: 萨鲁斯
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:2621
who: Salus, a bull-horned demon-kin of the Thunder-Gaol folk, nine hundred years old and looking in his forties, a wall-builder who stands beside the great demon-god of walls: about 232 cm, taller than a doorway, immensely broad and heavy-boned. Deep bronze-coloured skin, the Thunder-Gaol colour. A pair of thick horns growing out sideways, the left horn tip bound with an iron ring. A broad face with an old crack-shaped scar across the bridge of the nose. His hands are huge enough to grip a whole wall brick, and the knuckles are packed with grey mortar that never washes out. A heavy-lidded, slow, measured air of a man who touches every wall before he builds or breaks it.
palette: deep bronze, mortar grey, dull iron, soot black, a little dusty brick red
casual: His wall-builder's work dress: a heavy sleeveless leather jerkin over a dust-grey wool shirt with the sleeves bound tight at the forearms, a thick leather mason's apron, a wide belt, heavy trousers and iron-shod boots. A long-handled hammer, one head flat and one head pointed, rides across his back. One huge hand rests flat on a brick wall, feeling it. A slow, measured look.
private: Sitting on a half-built wall at day's end: a loose grey linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up, plain trousers, soft shoes, the apron off and folded beside him. He turns a wall brick in his enormous hands, feeling its edges. A quiet, slow look.
battle: Breaking and raising walls: the leather jerkin reinforced with iron plates at the shoulders and forearms, a mason's apron, heavy boots. He holds the long-handled hammer in both hands in front of his body with the pointed head up, planted wide; nothing is slung on his back. A hard, unhurried look.
formal: At a muster of the southern wall: a clean heavy leather mason's apron over a charcoal wool shirt, riveted iron shoulder plates with Thunder-Gaol lightning lines cut into them, a wide belt with a plain iron buckle, the horn ring polished, the hammer held upright at his side with small sparks running along its head. He stands very straight, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the heavy-lidded eyes looking down at the viewer with a slow, measured stare, a huge mortar-packed hand raised flat in front of him. Warm low light from one side, cool grey stone light on the other. Foreground blur: drifting stone dust and the edge of a brick wall. He wears the leather jerkin and mason's apron.

name: 卡尔泽因
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:2677
who: Karzein of the White Bones, the bell-keeper who calls the roll of the dead camps, eight hundred years old and unchanged since the day he became a legend, a bone-demon: about 194 cm, tall and so thin the bones show under his skin. Grey-white skin stretched tight over the bone. The left half of his face has no skin at all and shows bare bone (it is on the viewer's right when they face us); in each eye socket is a point of cold white light. He walks without making a sound. In his left hand he carries a small bronze bell, in his right a long iron pestle, one end blunt for striking the bell and the other end pointed. A precise, still, patient air; he counts everything. He has NO ordinary eye on either side: on the skin-covered right half of the face (on the viewer's left when he faces us) the eye socket is also a sunken hollow of shadow holding only one tiny point of cold white light, with no white of the eye, no iris and no pupil, exactly like the socket on the bare-bone side.
face: FACE, as in the references: a gaunt man's face stretched over bone: the right half (on the viewer's left) grey-white skin, the left half (on the viewer's right) bare bone; each eye socket holds a small point of cold white light instead of an eye; a thin closed mouth. Skin shadows a soft cool grey. Both sockets are dark hollows with one point of cold white light each; the skin-covered side has no visible eyeball, iris or pupil.
build: 194 cm, tall and gaunt: narrow, bony shoulders, a flat chest and long thin limbs.
palette: bone white and grey, charcoal black, bronze, a point of cold white
casual: His camp clothes: a long charcoal-grey wool coat of plain cut worn closed to the throat with bone toggles, a thin black belt, dark trousers and soft-soled boots that make no sound. In his left hand the small bronze bell on a short cord, in his right the iron pestle held low with its pointed end down. He stands very still, a cold white point in each socket.
private: Sitting alone in an empty camp at night: a long-sleeved, high-collared plain grey wool robe fastened with bone toggles, soft cloth shoes. He sits with the small bronze bell resting silent in his lap and the pestle laid across his knees, looking at the ground as if counting. A still, patient look.
battle: Walking up to the wall in the dark: the charcoal coat belted tight, a ragged short cloak of undyed grey wool over the shoulders, leather bracers. He raises the iron pestle in his right hand, striking the small bronze bell held in his left, one clear note. A cold, unhurried look.
formal: At the roll-call of a camp: a clean black wool long vest over a grey shirt, bone toggles down the front left open at the neck, a plain grey sash, a short cape of undyed grey wool with a row of small bone tags sewn on the edge, each tag cut with a camp number. He holds the bell at his chest in the left hand and the pestle upright in the right, the bell ringing faintly on its own, standing very straight, a grave, silent look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the cold white points in the empty sockets looking straight at the viewer, the bare-bone half of the face clear. Cold blue night light from one side and the faint white glint of the sockets. Foreground blur: drifting ash, the small bronze bell swinging near the lens. He wears the charcoal wool coat with bone toggles.

name: 嘉妮·铃尾
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:2734
who: Jani of the Bell-tail family, a fox-eared beastkin scout, twenty-one years old in the year she rode the long-chain land ship, born at a trade-road post: about 152 cm, small, thin and fast, running like a gust of wind. A pair of upright fox ears with a white tuft at each tip, a tousled short apricot-yellow bob that sticks up in every direction, eyes the fresh green of young grass that look at the ground more than at people. A fluffy tail with a small brass bell tied at its tip, the clapper ground down by herself so that its note is higher than anyone else's. A quick, talkative air that slows down and becomes careful when she speaks of shadows.
build: 152 cm, small, thin and quick: narrow shoulders, a small bust, a slim waist and narrow hips.
palette: apricot yellow and fox russet, fresh grass green, scout grey, brass
casual: Her Bell-tail scout outfit: a plain grey short tunic with fitted sleeves bound tight at the cuffs, grey trousers bound tight at the shins, soft boots soled with a thin plate of copper, an old wool scout's blanket worn folded across the shoulders and tied at the waist, a narrow leather belt. The brass bell at the tail tip. She crouches a little, looking at the ground by her feet with a quick, bright grin.
private: Resting in the ship's hold: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt, plain trousers and her boots hung round her neck by the laces, bare feet. She eats a cold crust of bread with great enjoyment, the tail wrapped round her feet and the bell muffled. A cheerful, easy look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: crouched on top of a ship's capstan with the knees bent and the feet spread, the ears pinned forward, the tail lifted high with the brass bell ringing, one hand cupped at her mouth as if shouting 'follow the bell, don't stop'; she holds no weapon.
battle: Leaping onto the capstan of the land ship: the grey scout tunic and trousers bound tight, leather bracers and gloves, the blanket tied round her waist. She holds no weapon; she shouts with one hand cupped at her mouth and rings the tail bell. A fierce, urgent look.
formal: At a muster of the long-chain crew: a clean grey scout jacket cut short with a brass pin at the collar, the sleeves bound at the cuffs, a fleet-blue ring sewn on the left sleeve, the blanket folded square over the left shoulder, trouser legs bound, copper-soled boots polished. She stands very straight with the hands at her sides and the tail bell silent, a bright but solemn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the grass-green eyes looking at the viewer with a quick, bright grin, the tufted fox ears upright. Warm lantern light from one side, cool grey haze on the other. Foreground blur: drifting dust and a brass bell swinging near the lens. She wears the grey scout tunic with the blanket across the shoulders.
